deployments_detail.use: Predictive storm readiness: uses historical weather and network-performance data to pre-position inventory and contractor capacity before hurricane season, moving from reactive to predictive operations. [none named]

Predictive equipment maintenance: analyzes power systems, HVAC, and obstruction-lighting data to predict component failures and inform generator/lighting maintenance programs (in development). [none named]

High-definition visual asset intelligence: investing in AI-analyzed imaging captured via drones, helmet-mounted cameras, and vehicle-mounted systems to build detailed tower asset condition data. [none named]

Multi-year alliance with PrecisionHawk to standardize AI-driven drone inspection of cell towers, using computer-vision analytics on drone imagery to assess wireless infrastructure. [PrecisionHawk (drone AI / computer vision)]

CoreSite (an American Tower company) certified as an NVIDIA DGX-Ready Data Center partner, providing high-density power and cooling colocation to host customers' NVIDIA DGX AI/ML training and inference workloads across LA3, SV9, CH2, and VA3 facilities. [NVIDIA (DGX-Ready Data Center program)]

Pilot with Dispersive at an American Tower Edge Data Center for secure, high-performance transport of GPU clusters at the edge, validating latency, throughput, resilience (sub-second failover) and security for AI/high-performance edge workloads. [Dispersive Holdings]

Collaboration with IBM to add IBM Hybrid Cloud and Red Hat OpenShift to American Tower's Access Edge Data Center ecosystem, enabling edge applications leveraging 5G, AI, and network automation for enterprises. [IBM (Hybrid Cloud, Red Hat OpenShift)]

Collaboration with Vertical Data to offer AI inference at the edge on American Tower's Edge Data Center infrastructure, helping enterprise customers run AI workloads with low latency near end users. [Vertical Data]
no confirmed internal AI deployment; positions edge data centers (CoreSite) to HOST customer AI inference workloads — infrastructure landlord, not own AI use

Data-driven field dispatch optimization: incorporates workload forecasts, contractor availability, and environmental impact to reduce redundant truck rolls and minimize carbon emissions across hundreds of thousands of annual service events. [none named]

deployments_detail.use: Vendor invoice anomaly detection: rules-based analytics flags anomalies in vendor invoices, such as duplicate visits and excessive travel distances, to control operating costs. [none named]

Hybrid 5G private network deployment with AWS (Outposts + AWS Regions + Athonet 5G core) using an AWS serverless automation framework to auto-provision networking, compute, and 5G core config from a single management console. [AWS (Outposts, Regions, Site-to-Site VPN); Athonet 5G core]

Risk-based tower inspection prioritization: AI/analytics flags high-risk structures based on age, geography, and past inspection results to schedule more frequent inspections across the U.S. tower portfolio. [none named]
